verdict.rationale: Aider documents a one-off `--message` mode that runs a single instruction and exits, an unsupported Python scripting API, and an event-driven `--watch-files` mode. None of these is a recurring schedule or workflow scheduler; running Aider on a schedule would need an external tool like cron, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. The axis is fair for an AI coding agent, so absence of evidence makes this "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
